text:
Emma (Product Designer): Quick poll — when a user lands on the Usage dashboard (org scope), should we: 1) show $ by default, 2) show tokens by default, or 3) show both side-by-side? Thoughts?

Raj (PM): I'd avoid side-by-side; too noisy. Default $ at org-level, with a prominent single toggle to tokens.

Lina (Frontend Eng): Side-by-side doubles DOM and layout headaches on small screens. Toggle sounds best. Persist user choice server-side.

Sam (Data Viz): Also consider the time window: short windows -> tokens are more useful. Maybe default depends on window: <7d = tokens, >=7d = dollars. Avoid surprising toggles if user explicitly sets a pref.

Maya (Accessibility): If we auto-switch, we must announce it via aria-live and show the manual toggle state. The toggle needs an accessible name like 'Display units: dollars or tokens'.

Dave (Billing): For exports and invoices always include canonical dollar amounts. If we show tokens, display an estimated conversion line: "420k tokens ≈ $34 (effective rate)" and show a small info link to explain rate/discounts.

Nora (Analytics): Add events: "unit_toggle_click", "unit_auto_switch", and capture scope/time_range/account_plan for analysis.

Emma: UX idea: default $ on org landing, but show a faint inline 'View tokens' CTA next to the chart title. Clicking expands a compact row that shows token totals + a convert-estimate. Keeps chart uncluttered.

Raj (PM): Love that. Keep the CTA subtle so account managers don't get confused, but obvious to engineers who look for tokens.

Lina (Frontend Eng): For the compact row, we can lazy-load conversion prices via /billing/rates to avoid extra onload latency. If rate missing, show 'Conversion unavailable'.

Sam (Data Viz): Also recommend compact numeric formatting: "$1.2k" and "420k tokens". When switching units, animate the value transitions (fade + slight vertical move) to preserve context.

Maya (Accessibility): Tooltip copy suggestion: "Tokens = raw model usage. Dollars = billed amount (may include discounts)." Also include sr-only full sentence when the conversion row is exposed.

Dave (Billing): Commitments: if account has committed discounts, use the effective rate; otherwise mark estimate. Cache rates for 5 minutes; invalidate on billing update events.

Emma: Action list: 1) Add inline 'View tokens' CTA + compact conversion row (I will mock), 2) Toggle component + persistence (Lina), 3) ARIA/tooltip copy (Maya will write), 4) Conversion API contract (Dave), 5) Telemetry events (Nora), 6) animation spec (Sam).

Lina (Frontend Eng): Estimate: toggle + compact row + aria + API integration ~3 dev days. Mobile: collapse CTA into the chart menu.

Raj (PM): Let's ship as an opt-in feature behind a feature flag so we can gather metrics quickly.

Emma: I'll add the Figma frames (frame id: usage/compact-token-row) and post links. Tagging everyone. :sparkles:

Nora (Analytics): Will add the event schema to the analytics board and link it in the ticket.

Dave (Billing): I'll publish the stubbed rate endpoint and include details about committed rates.

Sam (Data Viz): I'll attach sample animation snippets and a micro-prototype.

Maya (Accessibility): I'll review before QA and provide a short checklist.

Emma: Great — thanks all. We'll reconvene after mocks are up.
